correctness.description: Factual truth, mathematical correctness, code execution validity, and absence of logical hallucinations.

levels.5: Completely accurate, mathematically sound, code is syntactically and semantically valid with no flaws.
levels.4: Largely accurate, minor non-critical notation or syntax discrepancy.
levels.3: Moderate accuracy, correct core concept but contains a notable derivation error or unhandled edge case.
levels.2: Substantial inaccuracies, faulty mathematical derivation, or broken code logic.
levels.1: Fundamentally wrong, major hallucinations, or completely invalid code/math.

completeness.description: Exhaustive coverage of all explicit and implicit sub-goals in complex compound prompts.

levels.5: All multi-domain facets and instructions fully addressed with thorough depth.
levels.4: All primary facets addressed; one minor sub-question covered with slight brevity.
levels.3: Core domain addressed well, but secondary cross-domain requirement partially omitted.
levels.2: Multiple explicit sub-tasks omitted; shallow superficial answers.
levels.1: Fails to address the vast majority of the prompt's requirements.

coherence_synthesis.description: Logical structural flow, cross-subtask synthesis, resolution of contradictions, and readability.

levels.5: Masterful synthesis; unified explanation where multi-domain parts reinforce each other seamlessly.
levels.3: Understandable, but reads like distinct concatenated sections with abrupt transitions.
levels.2: Disjointed, contradictory statements between sections, or repetitive text.
levels.1: Incoherent, internally contradictory, or unstructured rambling.
